title: SkinMind: Equipping Agentic RAG with Human-Inspired Graph Probing for Reliable Dermatology AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.08935v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable dermatology AI requires access to verifiable evidence distributed across heterogeneous textual and visual sources. However, conventional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically relies on one-shot retrieval from flat corpora, limiting its ability to adapt retrieval granularity, explore multi-hop relations, and integrate multimodal clinical evidence. We introduce SkinMind, a multimodal agentic RAG framework that equips policy models with human-inspired graph probing for autonomous evidence seeking. SkinMind organizes retrieval as an iterative interaction between an orchestrator and a graph environment. Through eight hierarchical graph-probing tools, the orchestrator progressively identifies relevant entities, inspects node-level information, traverses relations and paths, and retrieves source-text and visual evidence. translated_title: SkinMind：为智能体RAG配备类人图探索能力，实现可靠的皮肤病学AI
translated_abstract: 可靠的皮肤病学AI需要访问分布于异构文本和视觉来源中的可验证证据。然而，传统的检索增强生成（RAG）通常依赖于从扁平语料库中进行一次性检索，这限制了其适应检索粒度、探索多跳关系以及整合多模态临床证据的能力。我们提出了SkinMind，这是一个多模态智能体RAG框架，为策略模型配备类人的图探索能力以实现自主证据搜寻。SkinMind将检索组织为编排器与图环境之间的迭代交互。通过八个层次化的图探索工具，编排器逐步识别相关实体、检查节点级信息、遍历关系和路径，并检索源文本和视觉证据。这种渐进式披露设计使模型能够自适应地确定检索模态、探索（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了SkinMind多模态智能体RAG框架，通过八个层次化的类人图探索工具和编排器与图环境的迭代交互，实现渐进式披露的自主证据搜寻，从而提升皮肤病学AI在异构多模态来源中的可靠性。
en_tdlr: SkinMind is a multimodal agentic RAG framework that employs eight hierarchical human-inspired graph-probing tools within an iterative orchestrator-graph environment interaction, enabling progressive-disclosure autonomous evidence seeking for reliable dermatology AI.
